posts.subject: Abschied
posts.bodyHtml:
So Leute...


Dies wird mein hoffentlich letzter Forum-Post. Ich habe etwas länger über diese Entscheidung nachgedacht und habe mich schließlich dazu entschlossen, das Team zu verlassen. Sollten euch meine Beweggründe interessieren, dann schreibt mich bitte an, diese hier zu veröffentlichen scheint für mich falsch. Zum Abschied möchte ich ein paar Personen danken für die tolle Zeit und die geschlossenen Freundschaften!
Danke Leute für die Erfahrung die ich erfahren durfte.

Spoiler

Die Reihenfolge ist nicht zu beachten


EDIT: TRANSLATION: I have to leave Dream. If you wanna know why i left Dream, pls contact me! I will miss you! I will never forget what you have done for me! Thank you for the great time!

Dear @Unicorn24


Sad to see you leave the admin team but I already know the reasons so I respect the decisions.


As a person, you were one of the kindest german person I have ever met on the entire community. Always here to hear my complains, listen to me, help me find solutions to my problems and more. You were one of the guys who was always having fun with me, I remember some nights we spend playing together. So much fun and I will miss your personality.


As an admin, you were a guy who was one of the best admin in this team in my opinion. Always trying to take the good decision, never think the opposite of you, you were a real asset to this admin team and it is always sad to lose assets. I will remember you as an admin in which I can trust at 100%. Always supporting players who needed support.


I will not forget you and I will always have time for you if you need help Unilove.


Regards
